title: Fiscal Year 2023 Consolidated Annual Report on Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena October 2023
doc_notes: This is a declassified annual report on UAP from the ODNI and DoD, which contains one specific case study of a resolved encounter.

encounters.summary: Military personnel reported five equidistant lights in restricted military airspace, which were later determined to be commercial aircraft.
encounters.entity_behavior: flew at a relatively constant pace
encounters.quote: equidistant lights that they believed represented a potential incursion
